cover: The cover of GPU-Accelerated Kubernetes. At night in a harbour, a raccoon in a dark blue cape and its natural black mask stands at a ship's wheel on the deck of a container ship. The containers are stacked in rows, and each glows with a green GPU chip. A stork flies overhead carrying a bundle marked nvidia.com/gpu: 1, a hound listens to a server with a stethoscope on the dock, and 5 parrots sit on a ring-shaped perch on the mast.
intro: Bundle, a stork, flies over a harbour at dusk carrying a cloth bundle marked nvidia.com/gpu: 1 towards a container ship. On the dock, a crane lowers a container that holds a glowing GPU chip.
ch01: Ledger, an owl in round glasses, sits at a desk between a large book of record on the left, whose lines are numbered v10, v11 and v12, and a small notebook on the right in which it copies each numbered line. A ribbon of paper carries events from the book to the notebook.
ch01-1: Rivet, a beaver in a hard hat, places a glowing GPU chip into an open pea pod. The pod holds 2 more peas shaped like containers, and a tag on the pod reads GpuJob train.
ch02: 8 hexagonal cells of a honeycomb are labelled SM 0 to SM 7. Bees fill the cells in rows of 32, and a lead bee named Comb carries a card that reads 1 unit = the whole GPU.
ch03: Doc, a hound in a white coat, listens to a rack of servers with a stethoscope. A monitor above shows a regular heartbeat line for 2 servers and a flat line for the third, whose lamp is red.
ch04: Sergeant Cone, a raccoon in a police cap, directs traffic at a crossing with a raised paw and a whistle. A traffic light beside it shows green for healthy, amber for cordoned and red for quarantined. A server with a red lamp stands inside a ring of orange cones.
ch05: Badge, a fox in a guard's cap, stands at a gate and hands an ID card to a new server that has arrived with a short-lived ticket. The card reads system:node:thor-3.
ch06: Shellby, a hermit crab, moves from an old shell on the left to a new shell on the right while carrying a stack of memory pages. A thin line of pages already sits in the new shell, and the last few pages fly across.
ch07: 5 parrots of different colours sit on a ring-shaped perch. Each passes a seed to its right-hand neighbour, and the seeds carry the partial sums 1, 3, 6, 10 and 15.
ch08: Flock, a sheepdog, herds 5 sheep numbered 1 to 5 together into 1 pen labelled shelf. A second pen labelled desk holds 2 sheep, and a gate stays closed until the whole flock is in.
ch09: 3 squirrels sit under 3 trees named shelf, desk and bench. Each holds a slate with a row of 3 numbers. After they compare slates, all 3 rows read 360, 120, 65.
ch10: Hash, a magpie, perches on a cabinet of small drawers. Every drawer is labelled with the first digits of a sha256 digest, and the magpie drops a shiny chunk into the drawer whose label matches it.
ch11: Chroma, a chameleon, sits on a branch above 3 terminals labelled linux, macos and windows. Each terminal shows the same gpuctl nodes command, and the chameleon's colour shifts from green to blue to orange along its body.
appendix: Kindle, a hedgehog, plugs a small GPU board into a shipping container labelled kind node. A cable runs from the board to the container, and a lamp on the container turns green.
